name: smwgraphics-treasure-hunter-g-aged-cave-ferric-falcon
title: Treasure Hunter G - Aged Cave (Ferric Falcon)
description:
A very detailed background from Treasure Hunter G. It's used in a cutscene at the beginning of the game.

Reripped from scratch, using the original game's tilemap. Best scrolling option for this graphic is Vertical: Costant, Horizontal: None.

Uses the final three colors of palette row 5.

A good fit for unusual levels.
